# Noise analysis FLICA components
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(effectsize)
```

## Load data
```{r}
behaviourals_all <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/FSL_pheno_second_filter.csv')

flica_dir <- '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Flica_Output/ABIDE/iterations1500/FSL_Format/150ica_secondfilter/'

# Subject courses: one row per subject, one column per IC
subject_courses_tp <- t(read.table(paste0(flica_dir, 'subjectCoursesOut.txt')))
subject_courses_tp <- subject_courses_tp[, colSums(subject_courses_tp == 0) != nrow(subject_courses_tp)]  # drop all-zero ICs

stopifnot(nrow(subject_courses_tp) == nrow(behaviourals_all))  # same subjects, same order
stopifnot(ncol(subject_courses_tp) == 150)                      # no IC was dropped, so IC numbers stay correct
colnames(subject_courses_tp) <- paste0("IC", 1:150)

# Modality contributions: one row per IC
modality_contributions_tp <- t(read.table(paste0(flica_dir, 'Modality_contributions.txt')))
colnames(modality_contributions_tp) <- c("JD", "VBM", "CT", "PA")
rownames(modality_contributions_tp) <- paste0("IC", 1:150)

# Multimodality index per IC
multimodal <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/multimodal.csv',
                       header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# QC measures, in the same subject order as the subject courses
surface_holes <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE_final_sitewise_all.rds') %>%
  filter(SUB_ID %in% behaviourals_all$SUB_ID) %>%
  arrange(match(SUB_ID, behaviourals_all$SUB_ID))
stopifnot(all(surface_holes$SUB_ID == behaviourals_all$SUB_ID))

IQR_all <- bind_rows(
  read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/IQR/CAT12_IQR_ABIDE1.csv'),
  read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/IQR/CAT12_IQR_ABIDE2.csv')
) %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = as.integer(as.character(SUB_ID))) %>%
  filter(SUB_ID %in% behaviourals_all$SUB_ID) %>%
  arrange(match(SUB_ID, behaviourals_all$SUB_ID))
stopifnot(all(IQR_all$SUB_ID == behaviourals_all$SUB_ID))
```

## Association of each IC with site and image quality
```{r}
site <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID)
age  <- behaviourals_all$AGE_AT_SCAN
sex  <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SEX)

eta_site <- r_holes <- r_iqr <- numeric(150)

for (i in 1:150) {
  y <- subject_courses_tp[, i]
  # Site: partial eta squared of site in a model 
  eta_site[i] <- eta_squared(lm(y ~ site + age + sex))$Eta2[1]
  # Image quality: correlation with FreeSurfer surface holes and CAT12 IQR
  r_holes[i]  <- cor(y, surface_holes$SurfaceHoles)
  r_iqr[i]    <- cor(y, IQR_all$IQR)
}

quality_table <- data.frame(
  IC         = 1:150,
  eta2_site  = eta_site,
  r2_holes   = r_holes^2,
  r2_iqr     = r_iqr^2,
  multimodal = multimodal$multimodal,
  JD         = round(modality_contributions_tp[, "JD"],  3),
  VBM        = round(modality_contributions_tp[, "VBM"], 3),
  CT         = round(modality_contributions_tp[, "CT"],  3),
  PA         = round(modality_contributions_tp[, "PA"],  3)
)
```

## Noise score and noisy ICs
```{r}
# One point per criterion; ICs with >= 3 are flagged
quality_table$noise_score <-
  (quality_table$eta2_site  > 0.14) +
  (quality_table$r2_holes   > 0.02) +
  (quality_table$r2_iqr     > 0.02) +
  (quality_table$multimodal < 0.40)

table(quality_table$noise_score)

noisy_IC_names <- paste0("IC", quality_table$IC[quality_table$noise_score >= 3])
noisy_IC_names
```

## Supplementary table for the thesis
```{r}
supp_table <- quality_table %>%
  select(IC, VBM, JD, CT, SA = PA, MMI = multimodal,
         eta2_site, r2_holes, r2_iqr, noise_score) %>%
  mutate(across(c(MMI, eta2_site, r2_holes, r2_iqr), ~ round(.x, 3)))

write.csv(supp_table, '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/supp_quality_table.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
